price_note: Hot spring entry plus the guided beer tour with 2 tastings
notes: Both near JR Naebo. Hot spring first: bathing after drinking is discouraged.

price_note: Museum entry is free; the izakaya course includes drinks
notes: Same brewery: taste at the Chitosetsuru museum, then dinner at its own izakaya. The museum closes 18:00 (17:00 on the last day of the month), so start by 17:00. Kissyo is closed Sundays.

price_note: Disaster centre is free; the critical care visit has no published price and needs a special arrangement
notes: Public hands-on disaster centre first (closed Tuesdays), then the critical care centre by arrangement.

price_note: Free dairy tour plus the guided beer tour with 2 tastings
notes: Two food factories near JR Naebo. Dairy tours run weekdays only and in Japanese; book by phone.

price_note: Run is free; one seafood bowl at Donbe
notes: Donbe opens 7:00, so this fits an early morning before sessions.

price_note: One chicken soup curry plus Clock Tower entry
notes: Weekday lunch at Soup Curry King runs 11:30-15:30.

price_note: One drip coffee at Marumi and Tokumitsu and one Mori no Shizuku at Morihico
notes: Sapporo's deep-roast coffee scene. Tokumitsu opens 10:00. Morihico is one subway ride west.

price_note: Matsuo eat-and-drink course plus one parfait
notes: Shime parfait: a Sapporo habit of ending a night out with a parfait. Both are closed Tuesdays.

price_note: Ropeway and mini cable car return, tram from Ropeway Iriguchi to Susukino (¥230), one bowl of miso ramen
notes: Free shuttle from the ropeway to the tram stop, then the tram to Susukino. Last ropeway up 21:30; Sumire serves until 24:00 (last order). Ropeway stops in bad weather. Weekday shuttle from 17:17.

price_note: Hotel by Otaru Canal (2 sharing), JR fares, free distillery tour, local tax, plus one Takumi nigiri set
notes: Distillery tour in Yoichi, JR to Otaru, sushi dinner on Sushiya-dori, night by the canal. Masazushi last order 20:30, closed Wednesdays.

price_note: Onsen hotel with dinner and breakfast (2 sharing), free shuttle, taxes, plus one seafood bowl at the Curb Market
notes: Free shuttle back from the hotel at 10:00 to Sapporo Station, then the Curb Market for a seafood brunch before the flight.

price_note: Hotel with dinner and breakfast (2 sharing) and taxes, highway bus to Noboribetsu one way (3,200), Upopoy admission, bus to JR Noboribetsu 450, JR local to Shiraoi 470, limited express Shiraoi to Sapporo 3,920
notes: Day 2: bus to JR Noboribetsu, local train to Shiraoi, Upopoy, limited express back (about 1 h). Upopoy is closed Mondays.

price_note: JR Rapid Airport return Sapporo–New Chitose Airport (2 x 1,230). Taxi airport–CIST, about 7 min each way, not included. The CIST visit needs a special arrangement
notes: Weekdays only. JR to New Chitose Airport, taxi about 7 min to CIST (ARIM shared equipment, clean room, Silicon Research Center; by arrangement), taxi back, then the domestic deck (Apr-Nov) for a distant view toward Rapidus IIM-1 across the airfield (two blogs, latest 2026-05-01). JR Rapid Airport about 37 min each way. SUMCO dropped: no visit program.
